title: KO2 all-terrain tire – 285/70R17
description: LT all-terrain tire aimed at mixed on/off-road use with good load capacity.

rules.notes: Common 285/70R17 upgrade. On 0–2.5" lifts many trucks need minor trimming at full lock and wheel-well liner heat-gun work.

title: 2" Tacoma suspension kit
description: Mild 2" lift focused on load handling and control.

rules.notes: Works on most trims. Check specific spring rates vs. bumper/armor weight. Often paired with 265/75R16 or 285/70R17 tires.
